title: Reinstate consent
purpose: End a withdrawal because the participant consented again or because it was recorded in error, and release its holds.

items.label: New consent record
items.description: The record made after the withdrawal, when the participant consented again; its decision becomes the status. When such a record exists it is preselected and must be chosen. The option None: the withdrawal was recorded in error is offered only while no consent has been recorded after the withdrawal; the status then returns to the decision of the last record before the withdrawal.

items.label: Reason
items.description: Required; kept in the history and on the released holds. Do not enter names, signatures, record numbers, birth dates or contact details of a participant.

sections.title: Four eyes
paragraphs: The person who recorded the withdrawal cannot reinstate it, and neither can the person who recorded a consent record made after it, whether or not that record is chosen; another manager or administrator must. Superuser status does not change this. For them the form is shown as not available with the reason, and the rule is checked again when you save.

sections.title: Rules
paragraphs: Only admin and manager can open or submit this form; other roles are refused. The server repeats every check when you save.
The form opens in a dialog over the page you came from; opened directly it is a full page. Cancel returns to that page without saving.

Not available when the consent is not withdrawn. The withdrawal and its holds stay in the history. If someone else changed the record since you opened the form, the save is refused with a message to reload; the form keeps your entries and the next save uses the current version, so check the current values first.
